matchupOfTheWeek.title: Rush Offense vs. Run Defense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our rush offense grades 55/100 (about average) against CHI's run defense at 13/100 (among the NFL's worst) — the widest statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: The Patriots head to Soldier Field for a Thursday night primetime matchup against a Bears team they've absolutely owned over the past 16 years—4-1 in their last five meetings, including a 19-3 shutout just two years ago. But here's what should have us genuinely fired up: Chicago's run defense grades out at a truly dreadful 13/100, and our rush offense at 55/100 represents the single widest statistical edge on the board this week. The real concern? The Bears possess the NFL's elite pass rush at 94/100, which could make life uncomfortable for Drake Maye, especially if A.J. Brown—who just dropped a career-high three passes in his return from a four-week absence—and the passing game are still finding their rhythm. We're coming in off three straight wins with positive EPA momentum (0.19 over the last three games) against a Chicago team that's been treading water at -0.05, which means if we establish the run early, we could dictate this thing.
